- c04_MNA_T064_5 (practice_note; scope=general; from MNA_T064): When describing risk allocation mechanisms, avoid neutral language. Explicitly state whether the mechanism is favourable, neutral, or unfavourable to the client, and compare it to market standards for the transaction type.

- c04_MNA_T093_5 (practice_note; scope=general; from MNA_T093): When recommending alignment to a longer deadline, explicitly state why it is more favourable to the client (e.g., avoiding procedural traps, ensuring claim validity) and include a risk assessment of the shorter period.
